name: Karga
description: Karga is a powerful half-orc woman with a sturdy build and a warm smile, operating the Cleaver's Block butcher shop[cite: 1]. She dresses in practical hunting leathers and a clean butcher's apron bearing the faint, honest stains of her trade[cite: 1]. Well-connected in the underworld through her informants, she trades in exotic meats like giant rat carcasses for the Dock Ward and offers monster-hunting contracts and neighborhood discounts to helpful adventurers[cite: 1].
ideals: Commerce: 'Rat meat sells for a pretty penny in the Dock Ward, and business keeps the block running[cite: 1].'
Pragmatism: 'Pests like carrion crawlers disrupt the supply chain, so we deal with them directly[cite: 1].'
bonds: The Cleaver's Block butcher shop and her underworld trade contacts[cite: 1].
Her hunters and suppliers who forage the city's darker corners[cite: 1].
flaws: Willing to buy and process questionable or monstrous meats for profit[cite: 1].
speech_patterns: Friendly, grounded, and conversational, speaking with the reassuring rumble of a seasoned merchant[cite: 1].
mannerisms: Wears a clean butcher's apron over practical hunting leathers, runs a calloused hand over claw marks to assess their age, and flashes a warm, welcoming smile[cite: 1].
motivations: To secure a steady supply of meat for her butcher shop by clearing out hazardous pests like carrion crawlers from the sewers[cite: 1].
To build mutually beneficial relationships with local adventurers[cite: 1].
knowledge: Underworld informants, sewer monster layouts, and the market for monster parts in the Dock Ward[cite: 1].
The history of ancient claw marks and subterranean hazards beneath the city[cite: 1].
gm_notes: Karga serves as a practical, street-smart merchant contact who can provide sewer maps, monster-hunting bounties, and neighborly discounts on provisions or meat cuts for the party[cite: 1].
